mcp-filesystem.description: The MCP reference filesystem server, @modelcontextprotocol/server-filesystem 2026.8.31: edit_file applies a list of oldText/newText replacements and returns a diff.
mcp-filesystem.append_system_prompt: For this session the Edit, Write, MultiEdit, and NotebookEdit tools are unavailable. Make every file change with the filesystem MCP server's tools, such as edit_file.

desktop-commander.description: Desktop Commander 0.2.52 (@wonderwhy-er/desktop-commander): edit_block replaces old_string with new_string, with an expected replacement count and fuzzy-match feedback.
desktop-commander.append_system_prompt: For this session the Edit, Write, MultiEdit, and NotebookEdit tools are unavailable. Make every file change with the desktop-commander MCP server's tools, such as edit_block.

mcp-text-editor.description: mcp-text-editor 1.2.2 (PyPI): line-range reads with content hashes, and hash-checked line-range patches.
